name: gladius-mcp
description: MCP browser-use server (npx launcher): provisions the pinned Chromium (chrome-headless-shell) plus the server runtime on first run, then serves MCP over stdio

scripts.preinstall: node -e "if(process.env.npm_config_global==='true'){console.error('gladius-mcp: global install refused — use npx gladius-mcp@0.4.2');process.exit(1)}"
